analysis.summary: The BBC spent time with far-left protesters in France whom President Emmanuel Macron has described as attempting to bring down the Republic. The article presents the perspectives of these activists, who express a desire to challenge capitalism rather than the French state itself. The piece examines how the government and these ultra-left movements view each other's aims.
